limitations: Scripted contact diagnostic, not a learned policy or training stream.
The known intermittent-contact defect is preserved; v1 continuous sliding is not accepted.
No D1 data, screen-dependent motor task, H800 policy training, physical FSR or real Apple trackpad validation.
Private harness and unaccepted pad module are not integrated into production code.
Stream is bounded by its declared deadline; status here is a timestamped observation, not a perpetual availability claim.
Teacher repeats a fixed task schedule; images and dynamics are recomputed rather than replayed.
Normal force telemetry is sampled at render times and is not reward or a complete force-safety audit.
